name: chandra_heart_of_fire_minus_nine_takes_any_number_and_adds_six_red
notes: Printed: '[-9]: Search your graveyard and library for any number of red instant and/or sorcery cards, exile them, then shuffle. You may cast them this turn. Add six {R}.' Candidates: Shock and Scorching Dragonfire (red instants, graveyard), Crash Through (red sorcery, library); not candidates: Opt (blue instant) and Goblin Arsonist (red creature) in the graveyard. Two of the three are taken (Shock, Crash Through) and the search is stopped: Scorching Dragonfire stays in the graveyard. Loyalty 10 -> 1, and the six red mana are in the controller's pool only.
